name: InsertOrUpdateJSONNodeWithPrimaryKeyNode
label: Insert or Update JSON Node by Primary Key
description: Searches recursively through a JSON structure to find an object where a primary key matches a given value. If found, inserts or updates a specified key-value pair.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: JsonContent
fields.label: JSON Content
fields.description: The root JSON token to begin searching. This can be a JSON string or a JsonNode.

fields.name: PrimaryKeyName
fields.label: Primary Key Name
fields.description: The name of the property used to identify the target object (e.g., 'id', 'name').

fields.name: PrimaryKeyValue
fields.label: Primary Key Value
fields.description: The value of the primary key used to locate the target object.

fields.name: TargetKeyName
fields.label: Target Key Name
fields.description: The name of the key to insert or update in the matched object.

fields.name: TargetKeyValue
fields.label: Target Key Value
fields.description: The value to assign to the target key in the matched object.

fields.name: UpdatedJsonContent
fields.label: Updated JSON Content
fields.description: The updated JSON content after inserting or updating the node.
